gloss: academic society, learned society, academic conference

definitions.explanation: An organization of scholars or professionals in a particular field of study.
A meeting or conference held by an academic society.

notes:
{学会|がっかい} has two related meanings: an academic society/association (the organization) and an academic conference (the event it holds). Context determines which is meant.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {学会|がっかい}⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧: conference presentation
- {学会|がっかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}する→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧: to attend a conference
- {学会|がっかい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}する→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧: to present at a conference
